SpaceX's mega rocket launched from South Texas early Monday and reached Earth orbit for the first time ever, according to TechCrunch. Reaching orbit brings SpaceX closer to regular commercial missions and cheaper access to space, which could open doors for builders who never had a shot at the industry before.
